doc.title: Story 2.11: Evening Timer and Win/Lose Conditions
doc.snippet: Story specification with acceptance criteria, tasks, and dev notes. Includes detailed implementation guidance for win condition check, game end handling, and integration with game loop. Win condition: timeRemaining <= 0 AND coziness > 0. Lose condition: coziness <= 0 (already implemented in Story 2.10). Game end state: isPlaying: false, gameOver: true. Game loop stops when game over. Event interactions disabled when game over. Final game state stored for results screen.

doc.title: Product Requirements Document
doc.snippet: FR8: The game tracks and displays the evening timer showing remaining time (60-90 seconds per evening). Timer decreases every second (frame-rate independent). Timer is displayed in HUD in "MM:SS" format. Timer duration is affected by player level (longer at higher levels, optional).

doc.title: Product Requirements Document
doc.snippet: FR10: The game ends the evening when either the timer reaches 0 (win) or «Затишок» reaches 0 (lose). Win Condition: When timer reaches 0 while «Затишок» > 0, the game ends with win state, results screen is shown, rewards are calculated (XP, «Світлячки»). Lose Condition: When «Затишок» reaches 0 before timer ends, the game ends with lose state, results screen is shown, partial rewards are calculated (if player made progress).

doc.title: Architecture Document
doc.snippet: Game Loop: Uses requestAnimationFrame for 60 FPS gameplay. Updates game state every frame using delta time for frame-rate independence. Game loop updates timeRemaining every frame using delta time. Timer countdown calculation: timeRemaining -= deltaTime. Game loop checks win/lose conditions every frame. Game loop stops when isPlaying = false or gameOver = true. Follow architecture document "Game Loop" section for frame-rate independent updates.

doc.title: Architecture Document
doc.snippet: Data Architecture: GameState interface includes timeRemaining property (number, seconds). GameState.timeRemaining is a number (seconds remaining). GameState includes isPlaying, isPaused, and gameOver flags (used for game end conditions). GameContext provides timeRemaining state and setTimeRemaining update function. Timer value stored in GameState interface.

doc.snippet: Story 2.11 focuses on implementing the evening timer countdown and win/lose conditions. The evening timer counts down from initial duration (60-90 seconds). Timer decreases every second (frame-rate independent). Timer is displayed in HUD (Story 2.13) in "MM:SS" format. Win condition: When timer reaches 0 AND «Затишок» > 0, game ends with win state, results screen is shown, rewards are calculated. Lose condition: When «Затишок» reaches 0 before timer ends, game ends with lose state, results screen is shown, partial rewards are calculated. Game end state: isPlaying: false, gameOver: true, game loop stops updating, player cannot interact with events anymore.

doc.title: Story 2.10: «Затишок» Meter System
doc.snippet: Lose condition fully implemented. Lose condition check: coziness <= 0 triggers gameOver = true, isPlaying = false. No changes needed to lose condition - it's already working correctly. This story adds win condition check and ensures proper game end handling.

doc.title: Story 2.1: Game State Management and Game Loop
doc.snippet: Game loop hook implemented. useGameLoop hook wraps requestAnimationFrame. Game loop updates every frame (~60 FPS). Delta time calculation available for frame-rate independent updates. Timer (timeRemaining) already decreases in game loop. Timer uses EVENING_DURATION constant (75 seconds default). Timer is frame-rate independent (uses delta time). Timer stored in GameState.timeRemaining. Need to check if timeRemaining <= 0 for win condition. Game loop checks isPlaying flag before updating (line 238 in useGameLoop.ts). Game loop stops automatically when isPlaying = false.

artifact.symbol: useGameLoop, gameLoop, deltaTime, timeRemaining, win condition check
artifact.reason: Main game loop hook that updates game state every frame. Already implements timer countdown (lines 129-137): const newTimeRemaining = Math.max(0, currentState.timeRemaining - deltaTime); setTimeRemainingRef.current(newTimeRemaining); if (newTimeRemaining === 0) { // Timer ended - game over condition will be handled by game logic // This will be implemented in Story 2.11 }. Need to add win condition check: if (newTimeRemaining === 0 && currentState.coziness > 0) { setGameOverRef.current(true); setPlayingRef.current(false); }. Game loop already checks isPlaying flag before updating (line 127). Game loop stops automatically when isPlaying = false (line 238). Lose condition already implemented (lines 147-153, 220-225).

interface.name: GameState Interface
interface.signature: interface GameState { timeRemaining: number; coziness: number; score: number; activeEvents: GameEvent[]; isPlaying: boolean; isPaused: boolean; gameOver: boolean; }
